messages.name: in1
messages.digest: Set a Y value for the next X
messages.description: In right inlet: The number specifies a y value to be stored in. The next x value (int) received in the left inlet causes the two numbers to be stored together as an x,y pair.

messages.name: int
messages.digest: Store an X/Y pair or output a Y value
messages.description: In left inlet: The number specifies the x value of an x,y pair. If a y value has been received in the right inlet, the two numbers are stored together in; otherwise,looks for an x value that matches the incoming number, sends out the corresponding y value, then deletes the stored pair. If there is no x value stored inthat matches the number received,does nothing.
